🔒 Privacy

Privacy Policy

📋 Section 1

Information We Collect

We collect personal information you provide when creating an account or using the platform, including:

  • Email address and display name
  • College, branch, and semester details
  • Files you upload and content you interact with
  • Usage data such as pages visited and features used
⚙️ Section 2

How We Use It

We use collected information to operate the platform, personalise your dashboard, improve features, support account access, and communicate important service updates.

We do not use your data for advertising or sell it to third parties.

📊 Section 3

Analytics & Cookies

We use analytics tools (Google Analytics 4) to understand site usage and improve the platform. Analytics only run after you accept the consent banner, and you can change your choice at any time in Privacy Settings.

Session cookies are used to keep you logged in. No tracking cookies are set without consent.

🤝 Section 4

Data Sharing

We do not sell personal information. We may share limited data with:

  • Service providers who help operate the platform (Supabase, Cloudinary)
  • Law enforcement when required by applicable law
  • Third parties only with your explicit consent
🛡️ Section 5

Data Security

We implement reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect user data from unauthorised access, including HTTPS encryption, session security, and access controls.

⚖️ Section 6

Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at abhihub.02@gmail.com or through the Contact page.

🗑️ Section 7

Account Deletion

To permanently remove your account and all associated data, visit the Delete Account page. Deletion is irreversible and removes all your uploaded content and profile data.

🔄 Section 8

Policy Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The revised version will be posted on this page with an updated date. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new policy.

For questions, contact abhihub.02@gmail.com.
